title: Possibly the worst toaster oven on the market
text:
Possibly the worst toaster oven on the market. The temperature is about 150 degrees higher than what you set it to. We have to watch our food if we're cooking anything for more than a few minutes. I can't tell you how many things we've burned. The timer is inaccurate, and you can't even dial it into the exact minute (you can with digital toaster ovens). After using it for about 7 months, the button that detects that the door is closed has stopped working reliably, so we'll often start the oven and then realize that it hasn't been toasting minutes in.

We had a digital convection toaster oven before this, and I wish we didn't get rid of it. It worked flawlessly for 8+ years. We bought this because of the reviews and the air fry function, but this has been one of the worst purchases we've ever made. It's inconsistent and the dials don't give you any real amount of accuracy. I'm currently looking to buy something else, and our next one will be a different brand and will be digital.
